prejoin.subHtml: You've been invited by a professional. Confirm your name and take a quick look at how we protect your data.
prejoin.nameLabel: How should the professional address you?
prejoin.privacyItem1Html: Audio and video are end-to-end encrypted — only you and the professional can see/hear.
prejoin.privacyItem2: We don't record anything. There are no tracking cookies.
prejoin.privacyItem3: Information shared during the appointment is under the professional's ethical and legal responsibility, in accordance with CFP Resolution No. 11/2018.
prejoin.consent: I confirm I agree to start the teleconsultation session. I acknowledge that the health data shared is protected by the Brazilian LGPD (Art. 11) and is subject to professional confidentiality.
